messages:
sam (PMM): quick kickoff  we need a short, engineer-first benchmark narrative for the launch post + 30min lab. anchor: an interactive budget slider + tiny curl + a live A/B routing demo in the webinar. two CTAs: try sandbox / join lab.

toni (writer): opener idea: "Match latency to intent. Measure the cost exactly." then a 3-line lede that points to the slider and shows example numbers.

harry (design): visual plan: hero = compact scatter + iso-contours + slider. below: 3 micro-cards (dev / product / infra) with concrete p50/p95 and $/1k deltas. will craft PNG fallback for socials.

mai (data): seeding CSV: `route,latency_p50_ms,latency_p95_ms,cost_per_1k,cache_hit`
`baseline,210,500,0.13,0`
`fastpath,75,160,0.095,0`
`quant-cache,40,90,0.037,60`
I'll also precompute contours for cost bands and attach small JSON to drive.

rachel (growth): inbound flow: sandbox -> auto-email with quickstart + code snippet; lab -> calendar RSVP + checklist. use utm=budgetplay / utm=budgetlab. add form field: "primary focus: latency/cost/security". route enterprise checkbox to AE queue.

mai (data): small snippet we can publish in the article: ``curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/generate -d '{"preset":"fastpath","payload_tokens":512}'`` returns sample p50/p95 fields. include CSV link for reproducibility.

toni (writer): copy outline: headline, one-sentence lede, hero interactive, 3 scenario numbers (table + CSV), how-it-works bullets (routing, cache, quant), CTA, FAQ about long prompts and quality regression. keep language compact.

harry (design): chart spec (pseudo): `x=latency_p50_ms y=cost_per_1k points=routes contours=isoCost(preset_grid)` tooltip: p50,p95,cost,route. mobile fallback layout ready.

labbot: bench-sim-511 complete. artifact: s3://redwood-bench/labs/511/contours.json. p50/p95 match Mai's CSV within 3%.

rachel (growth): subject lines to A/B test: A) "How much latency will your users tolerate?" B) "Pick the latency curve that fits your budget". recommend LinkedIn carousel of the 3 cards.

sam (PMM): assign owners & deadlines: Toni -> draft copy + social hooks by EOD. Harry -> hero mock + PNG by EOD. Mai -> publish CSV + curl example. Rachel -> forms + email flows. labbot/mai -> confirm artifacts on staging. sync 30m tomorrow 10:00am PT to sign off. thanks :rocket:
